answer: Clawback windows at the knoll: payouts vest 90 days, revocable if a peer audit flags duplicate identity proofs. An atlas of staked bonds backs each claim, so a sybil farm must lock capital across every fake node for the full lag period. The lagoon of unvested rewards drains first when slashed, making N identities cost N×stake with zero early yield. Cost scales linearly while returns stay frozen, so farming turns unprofitable before scale. This works because attackers must finance delay they cannot monetize.
